rule: Intra-session carbohydrate is prescribed only when expected session length > 75 min
summary: Guidance says sessions of about 30-75 min need only small amounts or a carbohydrate mouth rinse, and that intra-session carbohydrate matters for bouts over ~60-70 min (ISSN: especially past 70 min). 75 min matches those cut-offs. Supporting this, two randomised CrossFit trials (60 g/h glucose-fructose; 30 g cyclodextrin) found no performance or recovery benefit during ~1 h sessions. One caveat: a meta-analysis of resistance sessions found carbohydrate raised training volume in sessions longer than 45 min, mostly against fasted controls, which the pre-workout carbs already cover.

sources.note: Jeukendrup 2014: ~30 min-1 h needs no large intake; a mouth rinse may be enough
ISSN: intra carbs for >60 min bouts, particularly those beyond 70 min
CrossFit RCT (n=23): 60 g maltodextrin+fructose during the session did not improve performance, RPE or DOMS
CrossFit crossover: 30 g cyclodextrin across two 20-min WODs had no metabolic or performance effect
RT meta-analysis: carbs raised session volume (SMD 0.61), mainly in sessions >45 min and after >=8 h fasting
